description: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports - Regulations Media by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports under Section 41 Read with Section 31 of the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 as Amended.
reasoning: The gazette content is a set of regulations made by the Minister under the Sports Law, amending existing sports regulations. It deals with the creation and modification of legal/regulatory frameworks (eligibility criteria, election committee composition, registration requirements, etc.) for sports associations. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which cover new regulations, amendments, and statutory instruments. While a minister is named, the core content is the regulatory amendments, not a government personnel change or a hybrid announcement of portfolios.
